name: @dtronix/nexnet-workspace
description: npm workspace for the NexNet JavaScript client (@dtronix/nexnet) and its interop hosts.

scripts.build:types: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('packages/nexnet/types', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir packages/nexnet/types
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/check-types.js
